### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Compute the global maximum value across an arbitrary-sized vector in Triton using register tree reductions and masked tail lanes.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import numpy as np

def triton_max(x: list) -> float:
    return round(float(np.max(np.array(x, dtype=float))), 6)
```
